Who Will Pay for Increasing Biofuel Mandates? Incidence of the Renewable Fuel Standard Given a Binding Blend Wall.
abstract: We show that the cost of increasing biofuel mandates given a binding ethanol blend wall falls disproportionately on diesel fuel consumers. The extent of the burden on diesel fuel consumers is explained neither by their relatively more inelastic demand nor by blenders seeking to capitalize on the biodiesel tax credit. Relaxing the blend wall constraint by increasing the potential demand for high‐ethanol blends is the only effective lever to insulate diesel fuel drivers from the one‐sided welfare impacts of rising mandate levels. The independent effects of the nested mandate structure and the joint compliance base under the Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) generate the link between motor gasoline and diesel fuel markets. Our results highlight the importance of evaluating the incidence of the RFS in a holistic framework taking both ethanol and biodiesel into account.
abstract_zh: 我们表明，在乙醇掺混墙具有约束力的情况下，提高生物燃料强制配额的成本不成比例地落在柴油消费者身上。柴油消费者负担的程度既不能由其相对更缺乏弹性的需求来解释，也不能由掺混商谋求利用生物柴油税收抵免来解释。放宽掺混墙约束，即通过增加对高乙醇掺混燃料的潜在需求，是唯一能有效保护柴油驾驶者免受配额水平上升所带来的单边福利影响的手段。可再生燃料标准（RFS）下的嵌套配额结构和联合合规基数，产生了汽油与柴油市场之间的联系。我们的结果突出了在兼顾乙醇和生物柴油的整体框架下评估RFS归宿（incidence）的重要性。

venue: Review of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Indirect land use change, an agricultural market leakage, has been a major controversy over the Environmental Protection Agency's (EPA) requirement for corn-ethanol to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 20 percent relative to gasoline it is assumed to replace. This paper shows that corn-ethanol policies generate far greater carbon leakage in the fuel market itself. Hence, corn-ethanol does not meet EPA's threshold, regardless of ethanol policy and whether one includes emissions from land use change.
abstract_zh: 间接土地利用变化是一种农业市场泄漏，一直是美国环境保护署（EPA）要求玉米乙醇相比其所替代的汽油减少20%温室气体（GHG）排放这一规定中争议的焦点。本文表明，玉米乙醇政策在燃料市场本身产生了大得多的碳泄漏。因此，无论乙醇政策如何，也无论是否将土地利用变化的排放计入在内，玉米乙醇都达不到EPA的阈值。

Cost-Benefit Tests for GHG Emissions from Biofuel Production
abstract: Biofuel greenhouse gas (GHG)-reduction standards calculated via life-cycle assessment are shown to be biased, even when indirect land-use change is included, because they are based on physical GHG emissions and uptakes and on simple aggregates of balances. We offer a GHG-reduction standard for biofuel production free of these biases, expressed for a range of discount rates and an upper bound on the GHG payback period. A numerical example, based on previously used data, reveals that converting two land types into ethanol in Brazil satisfies our biofuel emissions test, whereas in the United States no land type satisfies our criterion.
abstract_zh: 通过生命周期评估计算的生物燃料温室气体（GHG）减排标准，即使包括间接土地利用变化，也被证明存在偏差，因为它们基于物理意义上的温室气体排放与吸收量，以及对收支余额的简单汇总。我们提出了一个不受这些偏差影响的生物燃料生产温室气体减排标准，该标准针对一系列贴现率及温室气体回收期上限给出。一个基于以往所用数据的数值算例表明，在巴西，将两种土地类型转化为乙醇的做法满足我们的生物燃料排放检验，而在美国，没有任何土地类型满足我们的标准。

title: The Social Costs and Benefits of Biofuels: The Intersection of Environmental, Energy and Agricultural Policy
abstract: The efficacy of alternative biofuel policies in achieving energy, environmental and agricultural policy goals is assessed using economic cost‐benefit analysis. Government mandates are superior to consumption subsidies, especially with suboptimal fuel taxes and the higher costs involved with raising tax revenues. But subsidies with mandates cause adverse interaction effects; oil consumption is subsidized instead. This unique result also applies to renewable electricity that faces similar policy combinations. Ethanol policy can have a significant impact on corn prices; if not, inefficiency costs rise sharply. Ethanol policy can increase the inefficiency of farm subsidies and vice‐versa. Policies that discriminate against trade, such as production subsidies and tariffs, can more than offset any benefits of a mandate. Sustainability standards are ineffective and illegal according to the WTO, and so should be re‐designed.
abstract_zh: 利用经济成本效益分析，评估了各类生物燃料政策在实现能源、环境和农业政策目标方面的效力。政府强制配额优于消费补贴，尤其是在燃料税次优以及筹集税收的成本较高的情况下。但补贴与强制配额并用会产生不利的交互效应：石油消费反而被补贴。这一独特结果同样适用于面临类似政策组合的可再生电力。乙醇政策可能对玉米价格产生显著影响；若非如此，效率损失将急剧上升。乙醇政策会加剧农业补贴的低效率，反之亦然。歧视性贸易政策，如生产补贴和关税，可能完全抵消强制配额的任何收益。可持续性标准是无效的，并且根据WTO规定也是非法的，因此应当重新设计。

title: The Economics of a Biofuel Mandate
The Social Optimal Import Tariff and Tax Credit for Ethanol with Farm Subsidies
abstract: We determine how the U.S. ethanol tax credit and import tariff affect the corn-ethanol-gasoline markets and how farm subsidies interact with these policies. We show how the ethanol tax credit and import tariff each uniquely affect the ethanol and gasoline prices. The ethanol import tariff alone increases the terms of trade in ethanol imports and corn exports, but decreases the terms of trade in gasoline imports and the tax costs of farm price supports. With price-contingent farm subsidies in place, the optimal tariff and tax credit will depend on the price level. When farm subsidy expenditures are high, import subsidies for ethanol may increase social welfare due to the substantial size of the fuel market relative to the corn market.
abstract_zh: 我们确定了美国乙醇税收抵免和进口关税如何影响玉米—乙醇—汽油市场，以及农业补贴如何与这些政策相互作用。我们表明，乙醇税收抵免和进口关税各自对乙醇和汽油价格产生独特影响。单独的乙醇进口关税会提高乙醇进口和玉米出口的贸易条件，但会降低汽油进口的贸易条件，并降低农产品价格支持的税收成本。在存在与价格挂钩的农业补贴的情况下，最优关税和税收抵免将取决于价格水平。当农业补贴支出较高时，由于燃料市场相对于玉米市场规模较大，对乙醇的进口补贴可能提高社会福利。

title: The Welfare Economics of a Biofuel Tax Credit and the Interaction Effects with Price Contingent Farm Subsidies
abstract: A framework is developed to analyze the effects of a biofuel consumer tax exemption and the interaction effects with a price contingent farm subsidy. Ethanol prices rise above the gasoline price by the amount of the tax credit. Corn farmers gain directly while gasoline consumers only gain from any reduction in world oil prices due to the extra ethanol production. Domestic oil producers lose. Historically, the intercept of the ethanol supply curve is above the gasoline price. Hence, part of the tax credit is redundant and represents “rectangular” deadweight costs that dwarf triangular deadweight cost measures of traditional farm subsidies.
abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个框架，用以分析生物燃料消费税豁免的效应，以及其与价格挂钩农业补贴之间的交互效应。乙醇价格会高出汽油价格相当于税收抵免的金额。玉米农场主直接获益，而汽油消费者仅因乙醇增产导致的世界石油价格下降而获益。国内石油生产商则遭受损失。历史上，乙醇供给曲线的截距高于汽油价格。因此，税收抵免的一部分是冗余的，它代表了“矩形”无谓损失，远超传统农业补贴的三角形无谓损失衡量值。

Economic Development, Institutional Change, and the Political Economy of Agricultural Protection
abstract: This empirical study uses 100 years of annual data on 11 agricultural commodities from Belgium to measure the impact of structural changes coinciding with economic development and changes in political institutions on agricultural protection. The analysis shows that changes in agricultural protection are caused by a combination of factors. Governments have increased protection and support to farmers when world market prices for their commodities fell, and vice versa, offsetting market effects on producer incomes. Other economic determinants were the share of the commodities in total consumer expenditures (negative effect) and in total output of the economy (positive effect). With Belgium a small economy, there was no impact of the trade position. Changes in political institutions have affected agricultural protection. Democratic reforms which induced a significant shift in the political balance towards agricultural interests, such as the introduction of the one‐man‐one‐vote system, led to an increase in agricultural protection. The integration of Belgian agricultural policies in the Common Agricultural Policy in 1968 coincided with an increase in protection, ceteris paribus. Both institutional factors, related to changes in access to and information about the decision‐making at the EU level, and structural changes in the agricultural and food economy may explain this effect.
abstract_zh: 本实证研究利用比利时100年间11种农产品的年度数据，衡量经济发展与政治制度变迁所伴随的结构性变化对农业保护的影响。分析表明，农业保护的变化由多种因素共同作用所致。当世界市场上这些商品的价格下跌时，政府会增加对农民的保护与支持，反之亦然，从而抵消市场变动对生产者收入的影响。其他经济决定因素包括这些商品在居民总消费支出中的份额（负向效应），以及在经济总产出中的份额（正向效应）。由于比利时是小型经济体，其贸易地位并无影响。政治制度的变革也影响了农业保护。促使政治平衡显著向农业利益倾斜的民主改革，例如“一人一票”制度的确立，导致农业保护增强。在其他条件不变的情况下，1968年比利时农业政策并入共同农业政策（CAP）与保护水平的提高同时发生。与欧盟层面决策参与渠道及相关信息获取变化有关的制度性因素，以及农业和食品经济的结构性变化，都可能解释这一效应。

abstract:
The views expressed in this paper are those of the authors alone and in no way represent those of the institutions they represent.
This paper calibrates a stylized national policy model of the U.S. dairy industry to analyze the effects of liberalizing the tariff quota policy. It is important to distinguish in‐quota, over‐quota, out‐of‐quota and nonquota imports. A framework to model quota underfill with out‐of‐quota imports is highlighted. To endogenize quota underfill and still account for out‐of‐quota imports, one needs to depict the marginal private benefits of imports under the quota and the corresponding marginal cost curve. The total transaction costs of the import quota scheme can be calculated. This framework is well suited for handling shocks because a change in in‐quota or out‐of‐quota tariffs or a shift in the excess supply/demand curves affects marginal benefits, while a change in the quota affects the marginal cost of imports. We show regime switches affect trade liberalization and that a decrease in tariffs or an increase in quotas may have little effect without liberalizing both instruments. A component approach to model the sector has endogenous government‐controlled class prices. An increase in imports of one product can result in an increase in the prices of other nontraded dairy products. This is because component prices change and so impact government‐controlled class prices.
Nous étalonnons un modèle de programme national stylisé du secteur laitier étatsunien pour analyser les effets d'une libéralisation de lapolitique des contingents tarifaires. Il est important de faire la distinction entre importation à l'intérieur du contingent, excédentaire au contingent, hors‐contingent et non visée par un contingent. Nous mettons en évidence un cadre pour modéliser la portion non utilisée d'un contingent en présence d'importations hors‐contingent. Pour endogénéiser la portion non utilisée d'un contingent tout en gardant en compte les importations hors‐contingent, il faut décrire les avantages privés marginaux des importations prévues dans le contingent et la courbe des coûts marginaux correspondants. Les coûts transactionnels totaux des régimes de contingents tarifaires 4aG l'importation peuvent être calculés. Ce cadre convient bien pour absorber les chocs, du fait qu‘un changement des tarifs douaniers imposés aux importations intra‐contingent ou aux importations hors‐contingent, ou encore un déplacement de la courbe d'offres/demandes excédentaires, se répercute sur les bénéfices marginaux des exportations, alors qu‘un changement du régime de contingentement le fait sur les coûts marginaux. Nous démontrons que des changements de régime influent sur la libéralisation du commerce extérieur et qu'une réduction des tarifs douaniers ou une augmentation des contingents peuvent n'avoir que peu d'effets sans une libéralisation réelle des deux instruments. Une solution utilisant les composants laitiers pour modéliser le secteur comporte un contrôle endogène de l'État sur les prix par catégoric de produits. Un accroissement des importations visant un produit donné peut se propager aux prix d'autres produits laitiers non visés par les échanges commerciaux. Une telle réaction vient du fait que les prix des composants changent et qu'ils peuvent se réverbérer sur les prix par catégorie réglementés par l'État.
abstract_zh:
本文所表达的观点仅代表作者本人，不代表其所属机构。
本文校准了美国乳制品行业的一个简化国家政策模型，以分析放松关税配额政策的效果。区分配额内、超配额、配额外和非配额进口十分重要。文中强调了一个在模拟配额未充分使用的同时计入配额外进口的框架。要使配额未充分使用内生化并仍计入配额外进口，需要刻画配额内进口的边际私人收益以及相应的边际成本曲线。配额进口制度的总交易成本可以计算。该框架适合处理冲击，因为配额内或配额外关税的变化，或超额供给/需求曲线的移动，会影响边际收益，而配额的变化则影响进口的边际成本。我们表明，制度转换会影响贸易自由化，并且若不同时放开两种工具，降低关税或提高配额的效果可能很小。本文采用成分方法对该行业建模，政府控制的分类价格是内生的。一种产品进口的增加可能导致其他未贸易乳制品的价格上升，因为成分价格发生变化，从而影响政府控制的分类价格。
本文校准了美国乳制品行业的一个简化国家政策模型，分析关税配额政策自由化的效应。区分配额内、超配额、配额外和非配额进口十分重要。文中提出了一个在存在配额外进口时对配额未充分使用进行建模的框架。要在考虑配额外进口的同时使配额未充分使用内生化，需要刻画配额内进口的边际私人收益及对应的边际成本曲线。可以计算配额进口制度的总交易成本。该框架适合处理冲击：配额内或配额外关税的变化，或超额供需曲线的移动，会影响边际收益；配额的变化则影响进口的边际成本。我们表明，制度转换会影响贸易自由化，若不同时放开两种工具，降低关税或提高配额的效果可能很有限。一种产品进口的增加可能使其他非贸易乳制品的价格上涨，因为成分价格发生变化，进而影响政府控制的分类价格。

title: Endogenous Commodity Policy and the Social Benefits from Public Research Expenditures
The Impact of Economic Development on Redistributive and Public Research Policies in Agriculture

The Economic Polity of Farm Policy
abstract: A review of the ‘new political economy’ of agricultural policies includes models of social income maximising governments, collective action by ‘pressure groups’, and the interaction between politicians and voters. An alternative explanation for Olson's “social by‐product” theory for why farmers received massive subsidies as a large group is also presented. An explanation for various patterns of farm policy interventions is given, including why rich countries subsidise and poor countries tax farmers. Finally, the role of public research expenditures and the interaction with commodity policy is explored.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了农业政策的“新政治经济学”，包括社会收入最大化政府模型、“压力集团”的集体行动，以及政治家与选民之间的互动。文中还提出了对奥尔森（Olson）“社会副产品”理论的另一种解释，即为何农民作为一个庞大群体却获得了巨额补贴。本文给出了各类农业政策干预模式的解释，包括为何富裕国家补贴农民而贫穷国家对农民征税。最后，本文探讨了公共研究支出的作用及其与商品政策的相互作用。

title: Why Small Groups and Low Income Sectors Obtain Subsidies: The Altruistic Side of a Self-Interested Government
Productive and Predatory Public Policies: Research Expenditures and Producer Subsidies in Agriculture
abstract: Governments are postulated to maximize a political preference function in choosing two policy instruments: research expenditures (a productive policy) that improve social welfare and production subsidies (a predatory policy) that incur deadweight losses. Each policy affects the distribution of income between producers and consumers. Governments determine the optimal mix of policies, taking into account interaction effects between research and subsidy expenditures. In addition to providing an explanation for underinvestment in research, the paper determines conditions under which research and subsidy policies are complementary. Such conditions are shown to characterize U.S. agriculture. Underinvestment in research is therefore less severe than in some other countries.
abstract_zh: 假定政府在选择两种政策工具时最大化一个政治偏好函数：研究支出（一种提高社会福利的生产性政策）和生产补贴（一种产生无谓损失的掠夺性政策）。每项政策都会影响生产者与消费者之间的收入分配。政府在确定最优政策组合时，会考虑研究支出与补贴支出之间的交互效应。除了解释研究投入不足的原因，本文还确定了研究政策与补贴政策互补的条件。这些条件被证明适用于描述美国农业。因此，研究投入不足的程度低于一些其他国家。

title: The International Effects of Farm Subsidies in the United States
abstract: Using dynamic programming, this paper examines effects of farm subsidies on U.S. exports of corn, cotton, rice, and wheat. The six policy simulations described here explore alternative proposals in the current round of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade. The analysis leads to two conclusions. First, abolishing domestic subsidies lowers world prices of these crops. Second, imposing tighter supply controls may not actually decrease exports in the short run.
abstract_zh: 本文运用动态规划方法，考察农业补贴对美国玉米、棉花、水稻和小麦出口的影响。文中描述的六项政策模拟探讨了关税与贸易总协定（GATT）当前一轮谈判中的替代方案。分析得出两个结论。第一，取消国内补贴会降低这些作物的世界价格。第二，在短期内实施更严格的供给控制未必会减少出口。

title: Explaining Price Policy Bias in Agriculture: The Calculus of Support Maximizing Politicians
The Political Economy of Commodity and Public Good Policies in European Agriculture: Implications for Policy Reform
On the Political Economy of Public Good Inputs in Agriculture
abstract: The paper analyzes two elements in explaining and prescribing the level of cost‐reducing “public good” inputs in agriculture: the distribution of political influence and the economic properties of markets. The incidence of costs/benefits of alternative cost‐sharing arrangements between taxpayers and producers is compared to the social optimal and competitive outcomes. Although one group could lose, we focus only on situations of a Pareto improvement. The model predicts why some sectors have relatively more public versus private research funding and why the degree of underinvestment varies across sectors. The observed underinvestment in agriculture may be due to the political power of farmers, inelastic demand, and highly productive public good inputs.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了解释和规定农业中降低成本的“公共品”投入水平的两个要素：政治影响力的分配与市场的经济特性。文章比较了纳税人与生产者之间替代性成本分摊安排的成本与收益分配，并将其与社会最优和竞争性结果进行对比。尽管某一群体可能受损，本文仅关注帕累托改进的情形。该模型解释了为何某些部门获得的公共研究资金相对多于私人研究资金，以及为何不同部门的投入不足程度存在差异。农业中观察到的投入不足可能源于农民的政治权力、需求缺乏弹性，以及具有高生产率的公共品投入。

title: Efficiency of Alternative Policies for the EC's Common Agricultural Policy
abstract: The Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) of the European Community (EC) is facing a crisis from budgetary and political pressures. This study analyzes the relative efficiency of four policy options discussed at the recent emergency summit in Brussels including a price reduction, coresponsibility levies, production controls, and a two‐price plan. These are assessed in terms of their efficiency in achieving producer welfare. A two‐price plan is superior to a production quota only at lower producer income goals. A price reduction policy is more efficacious than a coresponsibility levy, but both are shown to be inferior to either quotas or a two‐price plan.
abstract_zh: 欧洲共同体（EC）的共同农业政策（CAP）正面临来自预算与政治两方面的压力，陷入危机。本研究分析了最近布鲁塞尔紧急峰会上讨论的四种政策方案的相对效率，包括价格下调、共同责任税（coresponsibility levies）、生产控制和双价计划。这些方案依据其实现生产者福利的效率进行评估。只有在较低的生产者收入目标下，双价计划才优于生产配额。价格下调政策比共同责任税更有效，但两者均被证明劣于配额或双价计划。
